title: (To-be-deprecated) Supported metrics
content_data:
> **Important**
> GMV max ads reports only provide limited data and will be deprecated in the next API version. To ensure a smooth integration experience, run GMV Max Campaign reports for your Product GMV Max Campaigns or Live GMV Max Campaigns using [/gmv_max/report/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/run-a-gmv-max-campaign-report/v1.3) instead. You can use the following metrics in GMV max ads reports. ## Attribute metrics Attribute metrics provide basic attributes of your campaigns. ```xtable | Field {25%}| Type{10%}| Description{20%}| Detail{45%}| |---|---|---|---| | campaign_name | string | Campaign name | Supported at Campaign level (`data_level` is `AUCTION_CAMPAIGN`). | ``` ## Basic data metrics Basic data metrics provide data about spend and performance of your ads. ```xtable | Field {25%}| Type{10%}| Description{20%}| Detail{45%}| |---|---|---|---| | spend | string | Total Cost | The estimated total amount you've spent on your ads during its schedule. | | billed_cost | string | Net cost | The amount spent, excluding ad credit/coupons used. | ```
